name: codex-dashboard
description: Browser-based dashboard for managing Codex CLI agent sessions

scripts.pm2:start: npm run build && pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs
scripts.pm2:restart: npm run build && pm2 restart codex-dashboard
scripts.native:build: dotnet build native/CodexNative/CodexNative.csproj && dotnet build native/CodexNative.TerminalHost/CodexNative.TerminalHost.csproj && dotnet build native/CodexNative.Updater/CodexNative.Updater.csproj
scripts.native:publish: npm run native:publish:win && npm run native:publish:mac
scripts.native:publish:mac: bash scripts/publish-native.sh osx-x64 && bash scripts/publish-native.sh osx-arm64
